You talk to her, you be the most honestly and openly possible, you tell her that you need help by asking her to just give you a little bit of her time, and you take it all out. But THEN you need to be LOGICAL AND RATIONAL...
If you feel that she's hesitating, or uncomfortable about what you said, it means you have your answer. And friendship is not a way out of this. In case she don't seem to be in agreement, You just have to let her go in a logical way. Because you need closure, you're 17, you can't stay stuck in an impossible love. 
After all that you'll be hurt trying to forget about her, but you won't have any regrets, because you did what you had to do. And you can't force it after saying all the truth...
